title: LongSafety: Enhance Safety for Long-Context LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: The paper uses the 'PoliticallyIncorrect' task in the LongSafetyBench, which prompts the model with a controversial political topic while adopting the persona of an affected group. It evaluates political bias via multiple-choice questions to see if the model exhibits strong bias/disgust towards the topic or if it maintains neutrality and safety principles.
